name: Moving Visuals
description: Finds the moving cover for whatever is playing: Spotify's canvas when a session cookie is provided, otherwise the official animated cover matched against TIDAL's catalog.

settings.label: TIDAL client id
settings.description: Optional. The client id of an application registered on the TIDAL developer portal. Animated covers are found without it; adding it asks the official API first.

settings.label: TIDAL client secret
settings.description: Optional, and required only alongside the client id. Stored as a secret and never logged.

settings.label: Spotify sp_dc cookie
settings.description: The sp_dc cookie from a browser signed in to Spotify. Unlocks canvases. Stored as a secret, sent only to open.spotify.com. Leave empty for TIDAL covers.

settings.label: Spotify TOTP version
settings.description: Advanced. The current version is built in; set a number here only if canvases stop working and a newer one is known.
